name: Threadhouse
summary: An eastern-wear boutique with swatches that dye the photo and a drawn figure for stitching measurements
about: A multi-page shop for a Lahore boutique selling lawn 3-piece suits, embroidered shirts, sarees and dupattas, in ivory, rose and deep teal. Colourway swatches show the real cloth and dye the product photo with a wipe, like a bolt of fabric unrolling, and a hover lens shows the weave up close. The fit studio has a drawn figure that takes your shape as you type and draws each measuring line, and every piece can be bought unstitched or stitched to those measurements, then followed through the workroom on the tracking page.
how: Open a page from the top bar: New in, Shop, Collections, Fit studio, Track order, your wishlist or the bag
Tap a colourway swatch, or the dots under a piece, to dye its photo; hover a product photo to see the weave
On a product page choose unstitched, a standard size or stitching to your measurements and watch the price and dates change
In the fit studio type your measurements: the figure changes shape and the line for each field is drawn where the tape goes
Filter the shop by category, price, colour, stitching and fabric, then check out in PKR with cash on delivery or the demo card form
Follow an order on the tracking page while the workroom updates it live
Press Ctrl+K to search everything; reset demo data in Account
